Cybersecurity startup Zaperon has raised Rs 7 crore in a seed funding round led by Inflection Point Ventures (IPV). The fresh funds will be used to advance product capabilities, launch enterprise-grade AI security frameworks and expand its presence in India and the US, Zaperon said in a press release. Co-founded in 2021 by Vineet Gupta and Sachin Aggarwal, Zaperon is a cybersecurity firm that builds products to protect enterprises from data breaches. It offers a platform-centric approach to enterprise security that allows organisations to secure their entire IT landscape through a single Zaperon console. By bringing together identity security, data security and AI governance, Zaperon enables enterprises to control how users, applications and AI agents access and interact with sensitive data and cloud infrastructure. The platform aims to replace fragmented security controls with consistent, identity and context-aware policies across digital and AI environments. According to market research, identity security and data security represent an estimated $16 billion global opportunity today, which is projected to reach $35 billion by 2030. 30030b50a3.description: WillJini raises first round at $3.5M valuation, without pitching a single VC. Less than 1% of Indians have a will. For the other 99%, the transfer of property, bank accounts, investments, and businesses can leave families with confusion and legal hassles. WillJini has spent 12 years trying to change that, and has now closed its first external funding round without pitching a single venture capital fund. The estate-planning startup grew from Rs 3 lakh to Rs 50 lakh in monthly revenue over three years, using money from its clients to build the business. When it finally raised capital, the investors were people who already knew WillJini: SPJIMR MBA batchmates, close friends and some of its own channel partners. The latter are mutual fund distributors who sell WillJini’s services to end clients and, in this case, chose to invest in the company as well. "They approached us. They believed in the category before the market did," says Jugal Popat, co-founder of WillJini. The round values WillJini at $3.5 million post-money. Investors who participated in the round point to the size of the opportunity as well as their familiarity with the founders. "In my career spanning almost three and a half decades, I have seen more wealth destroyed by the absence of a will or a trust. Bharat has 1.4 billion people and crores of new crorepatis popping up, but almost no one has a succession plan,” says Priyesh Sampat, a Mumbai-based wealth advisor who invested in WillJini. “WillJini is making will-making as easy as ordering food online, legal, secure and affordable. This isn't just a fintech, it's a family tech.” Sapan Gandhi, an SPJIMR batchmate and investor, says he invested in WillJini primarily for three reasons: the massive market opportunity, a problem worth solving, and having personally known both the founders. “Living in the US, I've seen how established this industry is there. Blacksmith offers CI compute that is more performant, cheaper, and reliable. With Blacksmith, companies do not have to think about CI as they scale. 5a1173b496.description: Thunder Compute (YC S24) | C++ Systems, Infrastructure, BizOps | San Francisco (Onsite) | Full-time | https://www.thundercompute.com We're building the VMware for GPUs. Most GPUs in the cloud sit idle a lot of the time because they're bolted to one machine over PCIe. We decouple them. Our virtualization layer is a userspace shim, loaded through LD_PRELOAD, that intercepts CUDA calls and ships them over the network to a host with a physical GPU somewhere else in the data center. Workloads run unchanged. When a process goes idle, the GPU detaches and gets reassigned, and reattaches in tens of milliseconds when it's needed again. Think Ceph for GPUs: the GPU becomes a network resource a cluster-wide scheduler can pool and pack. The hard part is making that fast. We're within ~10% of native on most AI workloads, and it lets us serve ~1.8x more users on the same fleet. We run it in production as our own GPU cloud and sell it to enterprises with underutilized fleets. Team is from Citadel Securities, Aquatic, Old Mission, AWS, and Bain. Series A, $17.5M raised from Matrix and Y Combinator. Open roles: - Software Engineer, C++ Systems ($215K-$325K + meaningful equity). Low-level, latency-sensitive work on the virtualization layer. Quant dev / HFT background preferred: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/thundercompute/2efae53b-817c-43e7-9... - Software Engineer, Infrastructure ($150K-$250K + meaningful equity). Go, Kubernetes, reliable systems at scale: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/thundercompute/927a922b-c607-4b0e-a... - Business Operations Lead ($150K-$225K + meaningful equity): https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/thundercompute/4f28e418-b77b-446e-a... If you're cracked at building systems software and want to do something more meaningful than creating liquidity, reach out. Email me at carl@thundercompute.com and mention HN. I read every email.

We’ve both spent our careers at the intersection of finance and technology, and we’re using that experience to rethink how markets are analyzed, tested, and traded in the age of agents. Scalar Field is built around a simple belief: over the next few years, agents will not just help people research markets — they will actively participate in them. Underwriting a loan means pulling numbers out of a few hundred pages of paystubs, W-2s, bank statements, and tax returns, then applying underwriting guidelines that run to thousands of pages of edge cases. Most of it is still done by hand. Problems we actually work on: routing scanned pages to OCR vs. text extraction when the text layer is unreliable; extraction pipelines where a wrong number is much worse than a missing one; running long agent workflows durably so a failure three steps in doesn't restart the whole loan; and evaluating multi-step output against guidelines that are themselves ambiguous. We put real effort into eval infrastructure, because "the demo looked good" does not survive contact with a lender's compliance team. Stack: Python, PydanticAI, Restate for durable execution, Postgres, AWS. Frontier models from OpenAI and Anthropic plus open-source models where they win on cost or latency. We raised an $8M seed led by Kleiner Perkins and have paying customers in production. Team previously at Snowflake, PayPal, Twitter, Atlassian, and Microsoft. At Protex AI, we’re on a mission to protect the industrial workforce! We’re building a proactive computer vision tool for workplace safety - empowering industrial Health and Safety (HS) teams to identify risk and danger before it becomes a problem. 🤕 The Problem: Keeping people safe at work is extremely hard. In the U.S. alone, there were over 5,000 deaths in the workplace in 2019, mainly in the heavy industry space. Serious workplace injuries cost U.S. businesses circa $62 Billion annually. The platform plugs into existing CCTV infrastructure and enables HS teams to flexibly translate their document-based safety rules into the real world. Protex AI takes these rules and autonomously audits the customer’s facility to identify areas of high risk and non-compliance. HS teams can access this data via a reporting engine and use it in weekly safety meetings, external safety audits, insurance discussions, and legal claims. The tool integrates seamlessly with existing safety workflows to augment data produced by any manual incident logging system in place. 764dbf5a8c.description: Team size: 12. Customer service AI that resolves requests end-to-end. Typewise resolves customer service requests end-to-end. Someone sends a request; it reads the message, looks up the real order or account in your own systems, takes the action, and replies. Anything it shouldn't touch goes to a human. It works across email, chat, WhatsApp and social, and is MCP-native. Until now, that took a proper setup project, which is why it was mostly larger companies using it. Nova does the setup for you. You describe how you want things handled, in plain sentences: - "Handle refunds under €50 yourself." - "Anything about enterprise pricing goes to a human." - "Turn bug reports into Linear issues and assign them to the Excellence team." Nova connects the tools, configures the agents, tests them against your past conversations, and shows you what it got wrong before anything goes live. Nothing ships without your approval. First deployment takes 15 minutes. After that, it keeps going: it surfaces what customers keep complaining about, proposes fixes, and ships the ones you approve. We call it an AI Operator because it doesn't just answer customers; it keeps the entire operation working and improving. Across live accounts, that means 90% of requests resolved without human involvement. Your team stays in control of what it may do on its own. Hybrid intelligence handles partial hand-offs, review-before-send, and context-preserving resumption. We're YC S22 and work with companies like Superhuman and Unilever. Fortune 500 brands such as Unilever and DPD use Typewise to cut support effort by 50%+ while increasing CSAT and NPS. 7bd8cb6ddf.description: Prior Labs | Berlin, Freiburg, NYC | ONSITE | Full-time | Technical PM, ML Infra, Research Scientist/Engineer, Backend, Full Stack We build foundation models for tabular data. Deep learning transformed text and images but mostly skipped tables, which are still the data behind most clinical trials, financial models and scientific experiments. The reason is structural: no natural sequence, no spatial structure, no shared vocabulary across datasets, so the architectures and scaling laws behind LLMs don't transfer. Our approach: pre-train a transformer on millions of synthetic datasets sampled from causal-structure priors. The whole dataset goes in as context, predictions come out in one forward pass. No per-dataset training, no hyperparameter tuning, seconds instead of hours. TabPFN v2 was published in Nature and set a new state of the art; TabPFN-3 scales to 10M rows. 4M+ downloads, 8k+ GitHub stars, in production from liquid biopsy to rail maintenance. Code: https://github.com/PriorLabs/TabPFN Since July we're an independent lab inside SAP, with more than EUR 1B committed over four years. Models stay open, research stays public, same team and offices. Roles (most can sit in any of the three offices): - Technical Product Manager, Integrations: take every model release live across SAP (AI Core to SAP Analytics Cloud), the cloud marketplaces and customer environments, and help decide which channels we build next. Reports to me, close to the code. - ML Engineer, Infrastructure: own multi-cluster GPU infra (Slurm on GCP today, multi-provider next), training performance and the tooling layer. 7cc78babd6.description: WillJini raises first round at $3.5M valuation, without pitching a single VC. Less than 1% of Indians have a will. For the other 99%, the transfer of property, bank accounts, investments, and businesses can leave families with confusion and legal hassles. WillJini has spent 12 years trying to change that, and has now closed its first external funding round without pitching a single venture capital fund. The estate-planning startup grew from Rs 3 lakh to Rs 50 lakh in monthly revenue over three years, using money from its clients to build the business. When it finally raised capital, the investors were people who already knew WillJini: SPJIMR MBA batchmates, close friends and some of its own channel partners. The latter are mutual fund distributors who sell WillJini’s services to end clients and, in this case, chose to invest in the company as well. "They approached us. They believed in the category before the market did," says Jugal Popat, co-founder of WillJini. The round values WillJini at $3.5 million post-money. Investors who participated in the round point to the size of the opportunity as well as their familiarity with the founders. "In my career spanning almost three and a half decades, I have seen more wealth destroyed by the absence of a will or a trust. Bharat has 1.4 billion people and crores of new crorepatis popping up, but almost no one has a succession plan,” says Priyesh Sampat, a Mumbai-based wealth advisor who invested in WillJini. “WillJini is making will-making as easy as ordering food online, legal, secure and affordable. This isn't just a fintech, it's a family tech.” Sapan Gandhi, an SPJIMR batchmate and investor, says he invested in WillJini primarily for three reasons: the massive market opportunity, a problem worth solving, and having personally known both the founders. “Living in the US, I've seen how established this industry is there. bb5c0a5b1c.description: Team size: 4. The app platform inside Claude and ChatGPT. Floot is the layer where vibecoded software runs. SaaS is dead. Hundreds of millions of people already spend their day in Claude or ChatGPT - and increasingly, when they need an app, they won't buy one. They'll describe it, and it will exist. We're building the infrastructure that makes that real. When Claude creates an app, it needs somewhere for that app to live: a backend, a database, hosting, a domain, the ability to scale, various services, maybe even to be able to work as a mobile app. Floot is that place - a full stack purpose-built for AI to operate, from a specialized framework that defines how AI writes and runs code, down to scalable hosting on AWS. This means you can now build and ship real apps directly inside Claude and ChatGPT. Connect Floot, and the model you already pay for writes and debugs the code, shows a live preview, and publishes to your own domain. No need to wire up git, vercel, supabase and a dozen other providers. And no AI credits - every message runs on the subscription you already have, because we charge for the platform, not for a token markup. We built Floot this way because we've watched the model layer commoditize - every serious builder writes good code now, including us. The lasting value isn't another agent between you and the model. It's the layer underneath, from wherever people already are. We're building Floot to be the home for all operation software, for the decades where most new software on earth is written by AI. ✨ Try it: floot.com Artificial Intelligence, SaaS, No-code, Web Development, B2B, Engineering, Product and Design, United States of America, America / Canada

bd66c423dd.description: Team size: 3. The shared context layer for recursive companies - your work, your… Knowledge work is being restructured by AI. Strategy happens in Claude. Research happens in ChatGPT. Building happens in Claude Code and Codex. Meetings get recorded, notes get written, agents run for hours and leave behind traces nobody reads. The people defining the next decade of work are already thinking with AI every day. But none of that thinking compounds. Every session starts from zero. The reasoning behind decisions, the context behind strategies, the evolution of ideas across hundreds of conversations - all of it evaporates. Nessie is the infrastructure that makes it permanent. We auto-sync AI conversations and agent traces across every major provider - ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, and more - alongside meetings, notes, and email from tools like Granola, Read AI, Plaud, and Obsidian. Everything a team produces with AI flows into one place and compounds over time. Nessie turns that raw, heterogeneous data into an ontology: the live state of a company. Not a static schema but a continuously updated record of what the company knows, what it has decided, who owns what, and how its thinking has evolved, kept current as new work flows in. It is queryable from any agent through our CLI, MCP connector, and plugins, shareable across a team with real permissions, and deployable on-prem for organizations that need it. Then the loop closes. Once a company’s state is legible to its agents, every agent run becomes training signal: which skills worked, which failed, which workflows keep repeating. Nessie feeds that signal back as reviewable improvements to the skills, prompts, and processes the team runs on. This is what makes a company recursive: its agents get better from its own history, the people working with them get better too, and the compounding never stops. Where we are going: the AI-native organization runs thousands of agents

The Bengaluru based company will use the fresh capital to scale production of its F77 and X-47 electric motorcycles, along with its upcoming Tesseract scooter and Shockwave enduro motorcycle. The funds will also support the development of its next generation of EV platforms across battery technology, power electronics, vehicle architecture and intelligent software. Ultraviolette is targeting entry into the US market in 2027 and plans to expand across Latin America and Southeast Asia. It currently sells its electric motorcycles in India and 20 European countries. The fundraise comes after Ultraviolette announced a new manufacturing facility with an annual production capacity of up to 500,000 units. The latest round follows $66 million raised in its ongoing Series E round, including $21 million from TDK Ventures and $45 million from Zoho Corporation and Lingotto. With the latest round, Ultraviolette has raised $151 million across these disclosed fundraises since August 2025. Founded in 2016 by Narayan Subramaniam and Niraj Rajmohan, Ultraviolette develops electric vehicle platforms and battery technology. Its investors include Lingotto, TDK Ventures, Qualcomm Ventures, Zoho Corporation, TVS Motors and Speciale Invest. The company has developed battery architectures ranging from 48V to 400V and says its in-house technology capabilities span multiple vehicle segments. Lip-Bu Tan has also joined Ultraviolette as an advisor as part of the latest investment.

e5bc47a47a.description: Team size: 25. Ecosystem Platform for Restaurants in India Explorex — The Memory Layer for Physical Commerce ~90% of Indian retail happens in person, yet offline venues have no memory of their customers. Restaurants run on disconnected tools, and every visit ends with zero data captured. Explorex fixes this by owning both sides of the dining transaction. At the center is Elite, our consumer app that is redefining how people dine out. Diners see live table availability, browse dynamic menus, order, and self-checkout instantly — no waiting, no interruptions. We capture real-world, in-venue behavior — what people order, how long they stay, how groups behave, how menus perform, how experiences shape spending. Because we operate the restaurant OS and the consumer touchpoint, this data is irreplicable. We're now building Elara, an AI dining concierge that turns this data into real-time decision-making — factoring intent, context, availability, and historical behavior. This moves us beyond discovery into becoming the intelligence layer for offline commerce. Today, Explorex powers 250+ partner restaurants and 3M+ diners across Bangalore and Hyderabad, processing 8M+ transactions annually (18M+ lifetime), and operates at breakeven. Explorex is not a SaaS tool — it is the infrastructure layer for offline dining, with AI and consumer experience at its core. Think Shopify for restaurants, on its way to becoming the UPI of restaurant operations. Marketplace, Consumer, Consumer, India, South Asia, Remote, Partly Remote

According to market research cited by the company, the global Physical AI devices market, including robotics, automotive and drones, is projected to reach 145 million cumulative shipments by 2035. SiMa.ai said Physical AI applications have traditionally relied on NVIDIA GPUs, which can be expensive and power intensive. The company offers a full-stack Physical AI platform that combines purpose-built silicon and software to simplify deployments. Slated for H1 2028, the next-generation hardware will include machine learning IP, chiplets and SoCs. Hi Loop team,

I'm Aditya, a final-year B.Tech Computer Science student based in Noida, and I'd love to join Loop as a software engineering intern or in an entry-level role. Your current engineering openings are senior, so I'm writing to ask directly.

What draws me to Loop is the engineering behind the product. With 1,100+ brands migrated onto Loop, billing dates, payment methods and skips have to come across exactly right, and dunning and cancellation flows have to hold up when two events hit the same subscription at once. Those are the problems I enjoy most. This summer at Basepair I fixed a production OAuth race condition with row-level locking and led a cleanup that resolved 100+ high-severity defects across a Django/React codebase.

I'd be glad to start wherever I'm most useful: tests around migration and billing edge cases, fixes in the customer portal, or scripts that help your solutions team move merchant data. My closest project is MedVault, a full-stack React/TypeScript and Django app with JWT auth and per-user data isolation: https://medvault-xor.vercel.app

I've attached my resume and a cover letter with more detail on my projects. I can join immediately and work from your Gurugram office, and I'd be grateful for 15 minutes with someone on your team.

Best regards,
